home.title: Engineer, builder, *problem-solver*
summary: I'm a software engineer in Indore who builds web platforms end to end: Java and Spring Boot or Node.js on the backend, React and Next.js on the front, MySQL underneath and AWS to run it.
Today I own the full web platform at Apex Structure — the main website, backend and admin CMS. Before that, I led a team of 8+ engineers to deliver Alpha-Way v1, a B2B SaaS platform, at Jaitrrrm.

bio: I started with Java. After a B.Tech in Computer Science from RGPV, I trained as a Java full-stack developer at Pentagon Space and EduBridge, finishing with Grade A while building Spring Boot REST APIs and frontend integrations.

In 2025 I joined Jaitrrrm as a software engineer and team lead. I led 8+ engineers to ship Alpha-Way v1 on time and designed its layered Spring Boot backend: 50+ REST APIs with JWT authentication and role-based access.

Since December 2025 I've owned the web platform at Apex Structure: 150+ pages on Next.js and Node.js, 180+ secured APIs, and AWS infrastructure with CI/CD that brought deployments down to about 15 minutes. I care about secure APIs, clear contracts between frontend and backend, and systems the next developer can pick up easily.
